METALWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.

2. When learning Introduction to Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork.

3. When learning Safety in the workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

5. When learning Measuring and marking out tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools.

6. When learning Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

8. When learning Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester
